repo.description: Forge repo in 'owner/name' form. The lease's egress_allowlist pins the forge host.

tag.description: Tag name. Runner enforces semver (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional -prerelease and +build) to keep tags receipt-compatible.

target_sha.description: Full 40-char git SHA the tag points at. Short SHAs and refs are rejected.

notes.description: Release notes body, markdown. Typically the output of releaseops-changelog-extract.

draft.description: When true, the release is created as a draft (not visible to the public).

sign_tag.description: When true, the runner produces a signed annotated tag using the lease-scoped signing key.

summary: Create a signed, semver-validated release tag on a forge (GitHub/GitLab), with release notes. Per-call human approval; tag is immutable once published.
notes: Tags are intentionally hard to retract — even draft releases consume the tag name. The semver pattern is strict; calendar-version teams need a sibling card with their own validator. Pairs naturally with releaseops-changelog-extract upstream.
